tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression

No current decision on the transport compression codec is recorded for this project, so no codec is specified here. This policy will be filled in once a decision is recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no current decision on the transport compression codec is recorded, and it names no codec.

The decisions on record cover HTTPS, rustls and an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL, and none of them mention compression. `muninn why` came back "insufficient". The only compression-related matches were two bare one-word episodes, "gzip" and "zstd". Both are unverified (trust 1) and neither says what was decided, so I didn't treat them as a decision.
